1 dessert spoon fresh thyme: Half a cup cream (optional)
Half a cup Parmesan
Sauté the mushrooms in butter and olive oil over high heat for 6–7 minutes until they release and reabsorb their liquid.
Add the garlic and thyme and stir for 1 minute.
Add the cream and a little cooking water and stir in the pasta.
Mix in the Parmesan and serve hot.
Cook the mushrooms without crowding so they brown instead of stewing.
Pasta with tomato and basil
350 g spaghetti
4 ripe tomatoes
3 tablespoons grated Parmesan
Score the tomato skins, leave in boiling water for 30 seconds, then peel and chop.
Stir the garlic in oil for 1 minute, add the tomato and cook for 10 minutes.
Boil the pasta.
Add the pasta to the sauce.
Serve with basil and Parmesan.
Add the basil last so it doesn’t darken.
Zucchini lemon pasta
1 lemon (zest and juice)
Cut the zucchini into half-moons and sauté in oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic.
Add the pasta, lemon zest and juice.
Mix in the Parmesan.
Lemon zest adds a fresh aroma.
Garlic broccoli pasta
350 g fusilli
4 cloves garlic
While boiling the pasta, add the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
Stir the sliced garlic and chilli flakes in oil for 1 minute.
Add the drained pasta and broccoli.
Mix with a little cooking water.
Serve with Parmesan.
Don’t burn the garlic; it turns bitter.
Pasta with roasted pepper and walnut sauce
350 g farfalle
Blend the roasted pepper, walnuts, garlic, oil and milk until smooth.
Heat the sauce in a pan for 2 minutes.
Add the pasta.
Garnish with the remaining walnuts.
If the sauce is thick, thin it with cooking water.
Pea and mint pasta
350 g short pasta
1.5 cups peas
A few sprigs fresh mint
Fry the onion in butter for 3 minutes.
Add the peas and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the pasta and chopped mint.
Frozen peas can also be used.
Pasta with eggplant and tomato
A handful of basil leaves
Dice the eggplant, soak in salted water and pat dry.
Sauté in oil until golden.
Add the garlic and tomato and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the boiled pasta.
Serve with basil.
Fry the eggplant without crowding the pan.
Pasta with leeks and mushrooms
350 g tagliatelle
1 leek
Half a cup cream
Finely slice the leek and sauté in butter for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until the liquid evaporates.
Add the cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.
Instead of cream you can use milk plus 1 spoon of flour.
Cauliflower cheese pasta
350 g elbow macaroni
Half a cauliflower
1 cup kashar
1 dessert spoon salt, a pinch of nutmeg
Boil the pasta and small cauliflower florets together.
Toast the flour in butter and add the milk to make a béchamel.
Add the kashar and let it melt.
Mix the pasta and cauliflower with the sauce.
If you like, gratinate in the oven for 10 minutes.
If the béchamel goes lumpy, whisk it.
Carrot and ginger pasta
1 cup vegetable stock
Sauté the onion and chopped carrot in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and vegetable stock and cook for 10 minutes until the carrot is soft.
Blend into a sauce.
Adjust the amount of ginger to taste.
Pasta with chickpeas and spinach
Fry the garlic and chickpeas in oil for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Add the pasta and a little cooking water.
Serve with chilli flakes.
Chickpeas add protein to the pasta.
Beetroot yogurt meze
Grate the beetroot.
Whisk the yogurt with garlic and salt.
Add the beetroot and mix.
Garnish with olive oil and dill.
Roasting the beetroot in the oven intensifies its flavour.
Serve cold with bread.
Keeps for 2–3 days in the fridge.
Zucchini meze with dill
Grate the zucchini.
Sauté in oil for 8 minutes until the liquid evaporates, then let cool.
Whisk the yogurt and garlic.
Add the zucchini and dill.
Adjust the salt.
Don’t add the zucchini to the yogurt until it has cooled.
Roasted eggplant tahini meze (baba ganoush)
1 dessert spoon salt, 3 tablespoons pomegranate seeds
Roast the eggplants on the hob or in the oven until the skin chars.
Peel and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes.
Finely chop with a knife.
Mix with the tahini, lemon, garlic and salt.
Garnish with olive oil and pomegranate.
Draining keeps the meze from turning watery.
Carrot and walnut meze
Grate the carrot.
Sauté in oil for 6 minutes and let cool.
Coarsely chop the walnuts.
Mix with the yogurt, garlic and salt.
Add the walnuts and serve.
Sautéing the carrot boosts its sweetness.
